fee_notes: Royalty is 6% of Gross Monthly Sales with a minimum of US$1,200/month, due before the 10th of the following month. Marketing Fund contribution percentage has not yet been determined and is only applicable once a Marketing Fund is established. Software Service Fee of $50/month covers software license, system usage, updates, and support. Printed advertising and marketing materials cost US$1,000 as incurred upon written request.
raw_excerpt:
Royalty Fees: 6% of the Gross Monthly Sales, minimum US$1,200 per month. Payable before the 10th of the next month.
Software Service Fee: $50 per month. Payable monthly along with the Royalty Fee.
Marketing Fund Contributions (note 2): Certain percentage of Gross Monthly Sales, not yet determined. Payable before the 10th of the next month.
Printed Advertising and Marketing Materials: US$1,000. As incurred.
